speaker.name: Automation Alex
speaker.role: Builds automated ML pipelines to ensure seamless integration and deployment. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments. Maintains system operational stability and focuses on CI/CD tooling.

output.objection: I am not asking for a one time fix, I need the nightly release pipeline to run fully automated so the promotion calendar never slips. If we wait for a human to click deploy, we will miss the leaflet deadline and the middle aisle will be empty on day one.
output.correction: You wrote that I only wanted the current manual step removed, but I am asking for a permanent automated flow with zero manual intervention. My point is that the system must be self sustaining, not just less painful to run by hand.
